fields.statement: At 75c23faf ran `go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'TestDaemonNudge|Stall' -count=1 -v` (PASS: TestDaemonNudgeStalled, TestRunStalledNow), `go test -trimpath ./internal/session ./internal/daemon` (ok) and go vet (clean). TestDaemonNudgeStalled drives daemonNudgeStalled on a fake clock, a temp session store and a fake sender with one autonomous run (run State Autonomous true) and one owner-attended run: no send at 19m; at 21m silent without done the autonomous session gets exactly one message, asserted to contain 'background shell' and '`rhiza session done`' (attempt 1's finding fixed: the sender now receives the text); a poll at 25m on the same stall sends nothing; after a new report and 21 more silent minutes a second message is sent; the owner-attended session, stalled the same way, is never sent to; runStalledAll still lists both stalled sessions after the nudge; a failed send is retried next poll. Diff read: daemonNudge filters on the run's own st.Autonomous (not the daemon flag), keys stalls as session@report-time, persists Nudged in daemon state across restarts, and is called each poll in runDaemon. The test's stalled sessions report working rather than idle; the nudge path is state-agnostic (it takes runStalledAll's list), and session.Stalled stalls an idle autonomous-launched session the same way, covered by the run-session-idle-stall leaf's tests.
